preconditions.description: Grid dimensions n and m are at least 2, and movement cost w is at least 1.
Input has exactly n + 1 lines (1 header line + n grid lines).

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == m for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n grid lines contains exactly m space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each cell value is between -1 and 10^9 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: int(stdin.split()[0]) == n and int(stdin.split()[1]) == m and int(stdin.split()[2]) == w
preconditions.description: First line contains integers n, m, and w in order.
Start cell (1,1) and end cell (n,m) are free (not -1).

postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' (no path) or a non-negative integer (minimum time).
If a path exists, output is the minimum time to reach (n,m) from (1,1) using portals and adjacent moves.
